tagline: Discover the North. Live the Stories. Take Home the Memories.
pricing_policy: Source prices are indicative planning ranges, not verified supplier quotes. Preserve per-person, per-couple, per-group and per-day units. Never treat them as database booking prices or calculate confirmed totals from them.

products.name: Package 01 — Jaffna in One Day
products.experiences: Jaffna Fort, selected heritage stops, Nallur area, local market, traditional lunch and a sunset stop.
products.conditions: Final route depends on transport, guide, meals, entry fees and group size.

products.name: Package 02 — Island & Culture Escape
products.experiences: Jaffna city, a pre-arranged island excursion, local food, village activity and overnight accommodation.
products.conditions: Boat service and island access are weather- and operator-dependent.

products.name: Package 03 — Complete North Explorer
products.best_for: Visitors wanting a wider Northern experience
products.experiences: Day 1: Jaffna heritage and food. Day 2: island or village experiences. Day 3: a selected destination in Mannar or Mullaitivu, depending on starting point and travel time.
products.conditions: Offer separate Jaffna-focused and west/east Northern routes; do not overpack the itinerary.

products.name: Couples & Romantic Escapes
products.experiences: Sunset outing, private meal, photo shoot, island visit, accommodation upgrades and optional surprise décor.
products.conditions: Premium options depend on private transport, accommodation and photographer availability.

products.name: Family Holiday
products.experiences: Easy-paced sightseeing, island or beach outing where suitable, traditional food, crafts, family photography and rest breaks.
products.conditions: Provide child pricing, age limits, accessibility information and family room options.

products.name: Boys' Gang & Friends Adventure
products.experiences: Boating, fishing, approved outdoor games, food trail, group photography, camping or group stay where permitted.
products.conditions: Quote group rates and clearly list activity safety requirements.

products.name: Girls' Gang & Ladies' Getaway
products.experiences: Craft workshop, cooking class, guided sightseeing, sunset photos, shopping and optional wellness service through vetted partners.
products.conditions: Private transport and a female guide can be offered on request, subject to availability.

products.name: Solo Traveller Package
products.experiences: Small-group guided activities, cultural visits, food experiences and clear accommodation options.
products.indicative_price: Custom quote; single-room supplements may apply
products.conditions: State group departure dates and minimum participant numbers.

products.name: School, University & Corporate Groups
products.experiences: History and ecology learning, village immersion, crafts, team activities and guided visits.
products.conditions: Provide risk assessment, participant ratios, transport details and written permissions.

products.name: Paddy Planting Experience — Nel Nadavu
products.experiences: Meet a farmer, learn about the paddy cycle, try planting seedlings in a suitable field, take photos and enjoy a village snack or meal.
products.conditions: Only during suitable planting periods and with farmer permission; provide handwashing and footwear guidance.

products.name: Paddy Harvest Experience — Nel Aruvadai
products.experiences: Observe or safely participate in harvesting, learn about tools and grain processing, and enjoy a traditional food experience.
products.conditions: Available only during harvest periods; never promise harvesting outside the season.

products.name: Traditional Fishing Experience
products.experiences: Join a local fisher for a permitted fishing demonstration or trip, learn local techniques and enjoy a fresh catch meal when available.
products.conditions: Use authorised operators, suitable life jackets and safe weather conditions.

products.name: Crab Catching & Cooking
products.experiences: Learn local crab-catching methods in an approved lagoon or farm setting, then prepare a crab dish with a local cook.
products.conditions: Confirm site permission, season, food hygiene and whether catch is included in the price.

products.name: Prawn Harvest & On-the-Spot Cooking
products.experiences: Visit a participating prawn farm, learn about harvesting, collect prawns where permitted and cook them with local spices.
products.conditions: Arrange with an operating farm; harvest is subject to stock, permission and farm practices.

products.name: Maattu Vandi — Traditional Bullock-Cart Ride
products.experiences: A short hosted ride along an approved village route, with paddy-field scenery and optional photography.
products.conditions: Prioritise animal welfare, shaded rest, appropriate loads, experienced handlers and safe routes.

products.name: Traditional Village Photo Shoot
products.best_for: Couples, families, friends and pre-wedding clients
products.experiences: Photography in a permitted paddy field, village lane, craft space or coastal setting; optional traditional outfits and edited digital images.
products.conditions: Specify photographer time, number of edited photos, travel and outfit rental.

products.name: Pottery, Palmyrah & Craft Workshop
products.best_for: Families, school groups and culture lovers
products.experiences: Hands-on pottery or craft activity with a local artisan, demonstrations, take-home craft where available and a refreshment break.
products.conditions: Confirm the artisan, materials and whether the item can be completed and taken home.

products.name: Traditional Cooking & Market Trail
products.experiences: Visit a local market, select ingredients, learn to prepare selected regional dishes and share a meal with a host.
products.conditions: Offer vegetarian and allergy-aware options and clearly identify seafood or other ingredients.

products.name: Surprise Proposal Experience
products.experiences: Private scenic setup at a permitted beach or waterfront venue, flowers, proposal message, cake, photography and optional dinner.
products.conditions: For boat proposals, use a licensed operator, approved route, suitable weather and a safe anchored arrangement; never promise an open-sea setup without authorisation.

products.name: Birthday & Anniversary Surprise
products.experiences: Decorated table or room, cake, flowers, photos, special meal and optional boat or sunset excursion.
products.conditions: Set a clear guest count, décor limits, food inclusions and cancellation terms.

products.name: Pre-Wedding & Destination Photo Tour
products.experiences: A route across selected heritage, village, paddy-field and coastal settings, with transport and photographer add-ons.
products.conditions: Check photography permissions and religious-site rules before confirming locations.

products.name: Hindu Pilgrimage & Temple Trail
products.experiences: Selected destinations such as Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil, Naguleswaram, Keerimalai and Nainativu Naga Pooshani Amman Temple.
products.conditions: Check temple schedules, dress rules, ferry access and festival crowds.

products.name: Christian Pilgrimage & Church Heritage
products.experiences: Selected historic churches in Jaffna and Mannar and, where practical, Our Lady of Madhu Shrine.
products.conditions: Confirm service times, access and travel distances before booking.

products.name: Muslim Heritage & Cultural Trail
products.experiences: Pre-arranged visits to historic mosques and Muslim heritage locations, traditional food and community stories where hosts agree.
products.conditions: Visits require local coordination and respect for prayer times, dress and photography restrictions.

products.name: Buddhist & Sinhala Historical Heritage
products.experiences: Selected archaeological and Buddhist heritage sites, including Kantharodai where appropriate, with historical context.
products.conditions: Use a knowledgeable guide and present complex regional history respectfully.

products.name: Multi-Faith Northern Heritage Tour
products.experiences: A carefully routed selection of Hindu, Christian, Muslim and Buddhist/Sinhala heritage sites, plus colonial history and local storytelling.
products.conditions: Not every site can be visited every day; verify access, opening hours and local sensitivities.

products.name: Colonial & Northern History Trail
products.experiences: Jaffna Fort, selected museums, archaeological sites and district-specific historic landmarks with guided interpretation.
products.conditions: Entrance charges and guide fees should be confirmed in advance.

products.name: Lagoon & Island Adventure
products.experiences: Boat trip with an approved operator, island exploration, scenic stops and optional local meal.
products.conditions: Boat type, fuel, guide, landing permissions and weather affect price.

products.name: Mannar & Coastal Nature Escape
products.experiences: Selected coastal landscapes, Mannar Fort, baobab tree, birdwatching where seasonal and local food.
products.conditions: Route and bird sightings are seasonal; do not guarantee wildlife encounters.

products.name: Sunrise Fishing & Breakfast
products.experiences: Early start with a local fishing host, safe observation or participation and a breakfast stop.
products.conditions: Subject to fishing conditions, host availability and weather.

products.name: Nature, Cycling & Birdwatching
products.experiences: Guided cycling or nature walks on suitable routes, birdwatching and photography stops.
products.conditions: Provide route difficulty, equipment, water and safety guidance.

principles: Experiences are hosted with local farmers, fishers, artisans and residents; obtain consent and pay hosts fairly.
Do not promise all Northern districts in three days. Keep routes geographically realistic.
Farming and harvesting require actual season and host permission; do not invent seasonal dates.
Island access and boating depend on weather, permitted landings and authorised operators with suitable life jackets.
Religious access, dress, services and photography rules need confirmation. Respect all communities and their histories.
Wildlife sightings, supplier availability, accessibility and transport schedules are never guaranteed.
Celebration surprises remain private; confirm guest counts, setup permission and deliverables.
Only active SQLite package IDs and options may enter a priced builder draft. Unlisted proposed activities become wishes requiring staff review.
